summary.text: Chase Tramont represents District 30 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Tramont was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: The House lists Tramont's residence as Port Orange and an occupation of senior pastor. Tramont was born in Daytona Beach.
Tramont holds bachelor's degrees in communications and in history education from Flagler College.
